skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure ALB protocol is HTTPS

check_result.suppress_comment: HTTP only because there is no domain or ACM certificate. Setting certificate_arn turns this listener into an HTTPS redirect.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that enhanced monitoring is enabled for Amazon RDS instances

check_result.suppress_comment: Enhanced monitoring needs an extra IAM role and CloudWatch ingestion cost. Basic RDS metrics feed the CPU and storage alarms.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that RDS instances have performance insights enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: Performance Insights not needed for this demo. Support for the db.t4g.micro class was not verified.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that RDS instances have Multi-AZ enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: Single-AZ by default to avoid standby cost. The multi_az variable enables it for production.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that CloudWatch Log Group is encrypted by KMS

check_result.suppress_comment: Encrypted by default with AWS-owned keys. A customer-managed KMS key adds a monthly charge in this dev design.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure CloudWatch log groups retains logs for at least 1 year

check_result.suppress_comment: 30-day retention for a dev environment to limit storage cost, set by flow_log_retention_days.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that CloudWatch Log Group is encrypted by KMS

check_result.suppress_comment: Encrypted by default with AWS-owned keys. A customer-managed KMS key adds a monthly charge in this dev design.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure aws_availability_zones data source pins zone identity so its result set does not silently expand when AWS adds an Availability Zone

check_result.suppress_comment: Only the first az_count zones are used via slice(). Pinning zone IDs would add a region-specific variable.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 80

check_result.suppress_comment: Public web entry point on the load balancer only. Restrict with allowed_ingress_cidrs for private demos.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that load balancer is using at least TLS 1.2

check_result.suppress_comment: TLS policy applies to the HTTPS listener, which uses ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06 when certificate_arn is set.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that Security Groups are attached to another resource

description: Load balancer: HTTP/HTTPS in from allowed CIDRs, out only to the app

check_result.suppress_comment: False positive. Attached to the load balancer in modules/compute (aws_lb.this security_groups) via module output.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that Security Groups are attached to another resource

description: App instances: app port only from the ALB; no SSH (use SSM)

check_result.suppress_comment: False positive. Attached to app instances in modules/compute (aws_launch_template.app vpc_security_group_ids) via module output.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that Security Groups are attached to another resource

description: PostgreSQL: only from app instances; no outbound rules

check_result.suppress_comment: False positive. Attached to the RDS instance in modules/database (aws_db_instance.this vpc_security_group_ids) via module output.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that ALB redirects HTTP requests into HTTPS ones

check_result.suppress_comment: No domain or ACM certificate in this demo. When certificate_arn is set the HTTP listener redirects to HTTPS.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default

check_result.suppress_comment: ALB access logs support only SSE-S3 (AES256), which is enabled. SSE-KMS is not supported for this use.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS Load Balancer doesn't use HTTP protocol

check_result.suppress_comment: TLS terminates at the ALB. ALB to instance traffic stays inside the VPC on a port restricted by security group.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: No consumer for log-arrival events, so event notifications would have no target.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: Cross-region replication is not justified for short-lived access logs that expire automatically.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: Access logging for the log bucket itself would require another log bucket.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure public facing ALB are protected by WAF

check_result.suppress_comment: WAF has a monthly charge and this design is never deployed. Recommended for production.
